SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
S. 1, Special Branch Shanghai,
REPORT
Date October 26, 1939.

Subject International Employment Bureau.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen Ken Forwarded by ....................

The International Employment Bureau came into existence two months ago with an office in Room 232A, Hamilton House, 170 Kiangse Road. On October 16, it was removed to Room 107, 2 Peking Road.

It was opened by Mr. Walter Ascher, a German Jew. At present he acts as the Manager and Mr. E. Ruskin, a Russian Jew, as Sub-Manager. They are assisted by a staff of four Chinese.

Up to the present, 200 people have been registered as needing employment. Each of these is required to pay $1 to the bureau as registration charge and following obtaining employment has to pay the bureau $3 as remuneration. An application form which is to be signed on registering and an investigation report form are attached herewith. Some 35 of the registered have so far been introduced employment.

（批：D.C. Dept's The facilities requested! Nothing in form of official recognition given. Suggest they be informed accordingly.）
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH 27 OCT 1939）

Approved
Suggested
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 27 OCT. 1939）
Kao Yen Ken
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

Enquiries regarding Ascher and Ruskin ascertain that nothing is known to their detriment.

C. Crawford
D. I.

（印：DEPUTY COMM'R. (DIVISIONS) 27 OCT. 1939）

Applicant informed as above.
（签名）

D. C. (Special Branch).

上海特别处 S. 1，
报告
日期：1939年10月26日。

主题：国际职业事务所。

呈报人：特别巡官 高恩肯 (Kao Yen Ken) 转呈人：____ 

国际职业事务所于两个月前成立，办公地点位于江西路170号汉密尔顿大厦232A室。10月16日，该所迁至北京路2号107室。

该所由德籍犹太人沃尔特·阿舍尔 (Walter Ascher) 先生创办。目前他担任经理，俄籍犹太人 E. 拉斯金 (E. Ruskin) 先生担任副经理。另有四名华员协助工作。

截至目前，已有200人登记求职。每位登记者需向该所缴纳1元作为登记费，并在获得就业后向该所支付3元作为酬金。随函附上注册时需签署的申请表及调查报告表。迄今已有约35名登记者被介绍就业。

（批注：特别处主管：所请求之便利条件！未给予任何形式的官方认可。建议据此告知对方。）
（印章：特别处 1939年10月27日）
